frozen_problem: Given a database, fixed target workload, candidate extended statistics, and recurring statistics-maintenance budget, choose a physical statistical state minimizing CE loss on that supplied workload.

experiments.name: Census locality analysis
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: Census has sparse degrees but a giant component, so strict component decomposition is ineffective.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: All workloads lack useful decomposition.

experiments.name: Creation/OID-order probe
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: Creation/OID order can change selected MCV and estimate.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: OID precedence is DBMS-generic or globally optimized.

experiments.name: First-applicable pilot
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: Static first-applicable selection is not faithful.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: No simpler proxy can ever work.

experiments.name: MCV consumption/composition
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: Selected MCVs consume covered clauses in source-derived rounds.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: All PostgreSQL clause consumption is covered.

experiments.name: CE-Replay-IR-v0
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: A workload-specialized replay representation is feasible.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: v0 is the final exact semantics.

experiments.name: CE-Replay-IR-v1-A
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: Replay closely matches rounded/clamped plan observations.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: Residual observation error is semantic error.

experiments.name: CE-Replay-IR-v1-B
experiments.purpose: Compare external replay with native raw estimator
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: 4x32 designs match at floating-point precision; maximum relative error 5.55e-16.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: All PostgreSQL CE is replayed.

experiments.name: CE-Replay-Optimize-v0
experiments.purpose: Close a small exact optimization loop
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: Replay and native exhaustive optima agree for all feasible budget thresholds over 32 designs.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: Workload-scale global optimality.

experiments.name: CE-Replay-Optimize-v1
experiments.purpose: Scale MCV design and affected-query evaluation
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: Replay drives workload-scale selection and affected-query evaluation.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: The reported design is globally optimal.

experiments.name: CE-Replay-Optimize-v2
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: Global budget exchange makes locality-only swap restriction incomplete.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: Locality cannot help move evaluation.

experiments.name: CE-Replay-Optimize-v3
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: Precedence can be treated as a PostgreSQL-specific realization variable.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: Arbitrary precedence global optimum is found.

experiments.name: MCV-Deploy-v0
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: Recorded selection/order can be physically realized and replayed.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: Mixed mechanism closure.

experiments.name: FD-Semantics-v0
experiments.semantic_scope: Equality-eligible FD base restrictions including node probes
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: Supported FD semantics match native behavior and compose after MCV consumption.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: All FD/planner semantics are covered.

experiments.name: CE-Replay-Optimize-v4
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: Joint semantics outperform independent mechanism optimization and avoid suppressed FDs.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: All selected mechanisms always consume or global optimum.

experiments.name: CE-Semantic-State-v0
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: Execution-sufficient projected state need not be extension-safe after design changes.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: No state compression is possible.

experiments.name: MCV-Commutativity-v0
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: Local commutativity does not reduce the tested canonical outer design space.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: MCV operations never commute.

experiments.name: MCV-Semantic-Factorization-v0
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: Exact reconstruction works, but fixed Census query-local graphs yield no nontrivial factors.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: Factorization is impossible on other workloads.

experiments.name: Semantic-Move-Pruning-v0
experiments.purpose: Audit source-derived invalidation in one move round
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: Semantic invalidation reduces control replay without changing audited move values.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: End-to-end speedup is guaranteed.

experiments.name: Semantic-Optimizer-v0
experiments.purpose: Run exact incremental MCV local search
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: The 17-move trajectory and terminal round match the control evaluator with 171.31x fewer control replays and 3.51x phase speedup.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: Global optimum or general end-to-end speedup.

experiments.name: Compositional-Semantic-Optimizer-v0
experiments.purpose: Run exact incremental mixed local search
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: Exact mixed trajectory is preserved and cross-mechanism invalidation is captured.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: The implementation is faster wall-clock; it was 145.68s versus 45.05s control.

experiments.name: Mixed-Deploy-v0
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: Fresh replay/native match and frozen-to-fresh drift can be separated.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: Fresh objective equals frozen objective.

experiments.name: Research-Synthesis-v0
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: The project spine is executable semantics plus replaceable search.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: Independent experimental evidence.

experiments.name: Repeated-Analyze-Robustness-v0
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: 14040/14040 replay/native matches across 30 ANALYZE runs; objective CV 1.835%.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: Payload realizations are stable or universal.

experiments.name: Workload-Generalization-v0
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: IID held-out transfer can be measured in this inspected dataset.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: Untouched unseen-template generalization.

experiments.name: Generalization-Mechanism-Analysis-v0
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: Many transfer failures can be diagnosed post hoc.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: A validated generalization-aware optimizer.

experiments.name: Budget-Generalization-Curve-v0
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: Train-improving/test-worsening transitions occur in the inspected setup.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: A general law of budget and generalization.

experiments.name: Census structural-group audit
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: Three tested signatures yield singleton groups.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: Census has a unified query template.

experiments.name: Structural-Distance-Generalization-v0
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: Simple structural distance poorly explains transfer in this setup.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: Structural distance never matters.

experiments.name: Statistics-Nonmonotonicity-v0
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: 1560/3011 singleton additions are harmful and 317 removals from all improve loss; all is worse than optimized subset.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: Non-monotonicity is universal.

experiments.name: Analyze-Cost-Model-v0
experiments.semantic_scope: Aggregate ANALYZE latency for pair MCV/FD
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: First-order slopes are 1.874997 ms/MCV and 2.717261 ms/FD; ratio 1.449.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: Portable or candidate-specific PostgreSQL costs.

experiments.name: Maintenance-Budget-Optimize-v0
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: At B=286.144, 276 MCV+7 FD yield loss 787.809381 and materially differ from byte-budget design.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: Global optimum or universal coefficients.

experiments.name: Maintenance-Design-Deploy-v0
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: Exact design/order realized; 468/468 fresh replay/native match; paired drift 3.0140%; ANALYZE prediction error 7.20%.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: Repeated superiority or zero payload drift.

experiments.name: DMV-Fit-Audit-v0
experiments.purpose: Audit second-workload fit and semantic gaps
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: DMV is dense, IN-heavy, structurally different, and required bounded ScalarArray support.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: Different dataset alone proves external validity.

experiments.name: MCV-ScalarArray-Semantics-v0
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: 29/29 synthetic and 128/128 regressions pass; DMV coverage rises 52/1965 to 1965/1965.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: Arbitrary ScalarArray/operator/predicate support.

experiments.name: DMV-Baseline-and-Nonmonotonicity-v0
experiments.purpose: Validate real workload replay and inclusion behavior
experiments.semantic_scope: 36 MCV+34 usable FD, one frozen realization
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: 27510/27510 matches; 45/70 usable singleton additions harmful; 17 improving removals; all-statistics suppresses every FD.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: Absolute losses transfer to the later optimization realization.

experiments.name: DMV-Analyze-Cost-Model-v0
experiments.semantic_scope: Aggregate ANALYZE latency for 36 MCV+34 FD
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: Combined coefficients 3.903845/5.907345 ms, ratio 1.51321194, R2 0.974868; full mixed error 3.7133%.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: High-precision latency prediction; deployment error was 21.4295%.

experiments.name: DMV-Maintenance-Budget-Optimize-v0
experiments.semantic_scope: New internally consistent 36 MCV+34 FD frozen realization
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: 11 MCV+12 FD local optimum, cost 29.158543 under budget 43.724603; 4/4 restricted exact recovery; 67.91% replay work avoided.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: Full-instance global optimum or Census-scale scalability.

experiments.name: DMV-Deploy-v0
experiments.purpose: Physically deploy and validate the selected design
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: Exact design/order realized; 1965/1965 fresh replay/native matches; 11 MCV and 11 materialized FD consumed.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: Complete paired frozen-to-fresh per-query drift audit.

experiments.name: DMV-Frozen-Provenance-Recovery-v0
experiments.purpose: Audit recovery of missing frozen per-query state
experiments.strongest_supported_claim: Frozen per-query estimates and required simple-selectivity context are unrecoverable; fresh semantic claims remain independently supported.
experiments.strongest_unsupported_overclaim: The omission is a semantic correctness failure.

minimum_core_chain: Semantic-Optimizer-v0 + Compositional-Semantic-Optimizer-v0 + DMV dense incremental audit
final_gate: EXPERIMENTAL PHASE COMPLETE — READY FOR PAPER CONSTRUCTION
